content: GitHub Pages cannot set custom response headers (no COOP/COEP), confirmed via github/community discussion #13309 (long-standing feature request, unresolved). This blocks SharedArrayBuffer and therefore DuckDB-Wasm's multi-threaded ('coi'/pthreads) bundle. Workarounds like the coi-serviceworker library exist (a service worker that intercepts requests and injects the headers client-side) but add complexity/fragility. Recommended approach: do NOT attempt cross-origin isolation on GitHub Pages; rely on duckdb-wasm's automatic fallback to the single-threaded 'eh' bundle, which is sufficient for single-Parquet-file, moderate-size survey datasets.
